name: In-process
summary: The agent loop runs as ordinary code inside one process, with state held in memory. Nothing is checkpointed, so a crash, deploy or timeout loses the run and it has to start over. It is the default for scripts, CLIs and prototypes.
how: Start the agent loop inside your server or CLI process
Keep conversation and tool state in memory (optionally save transcripts at the end)
Retry failed calls with simple in-code retry logic
On crash or redeploy, rerun the task from the beginning
facts: Run is lost on crash, deploy or timeout
Simplest to build; no resume or exactly-once side effects
goodFor: Short tasks that are cheap to rerun
watchOut: Long runs die on serverless timeouts
Side effects may repeat when rerun
